level1.title: Jesus Forgives
level1.story: Some leaders brought a woman to Jesus to trap Him. Jesus said, "Whoever has no sin can throw the first stone." They all left. Jesus said, "Go, and sin no more."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus write on the ground?
level1.prayer: Jesus, forgive me and help me forgive. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus forgives me
activity.intro: Fill the cross with fingerprints. Jesus forgives!
activity.label: Jesus forgives me

level2.title: Go and Sin No More
level2.story: The scribes and Pharisees brought a woman caught in sin and set her before Jesus. They said, "Moses commanded us to stone such a one. But what sayest Thou?" Jesus bent down and wrote with His finger on the ground. He said, "He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her." One by one they all went away, and Jesus said, "Neither will I condemn thee. Go, and now sin no more."
level2.keyLine: Neither will I condemn thee. Go, and now sin no more.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did the accusers walk away?
Why did Jesus say 'sin no more' too?
level2.prayer: Jesus, have mercy on me and help me change. Amen.
